This is a compilation of the following five works:

(page 05-26) (June 2014 release) マキライブ！
(page 27-48) (August 2014 release) MAKI LESSON
(page 49-70) (October 2014 release) MAKI HOLE
(page 71-88) (December 2014 release) ちょろマキ
(page 89-96) (Newly drawn manga for this compilation) マキワイフ！

- Many years ago, I discovered this series of Maki doujins by this artist, and I always felt a little disappointed that there wasn’t a digital version of them published on the site. Then, one day, I found the page where the official digital version is sold, and I wanted to share it with all of you. I hope you enjoy it.
